column3: prompt (tab-separated). "fire" cases must invoke the skill; "quiet" cases must not.
Can you look over the changes on my branch before I merge? I want to know if anything is broken or insecure.
What is the difference between git merge and git rebase?
I've got a merge conflict in package-lock.json and two services after pulling develop. How should I sort it out?
Write a Python function that parses ISO dates.
This branch is finished. Please open a pull request for it.
What makes a good pull request description, in general terms?
My pull request #42 keeps failing CI. Can you watch it and get it merged?
How do GitHub Actions workflow triggers work?
Build the Tauri app for release and then clear out the target folder, it's eating my disc space.
Why is my Rust code failing to compile with a lifetime error?
Add a changelog entry for what I've staged before I commit.
Show me the last five commits on this branch.
I changed the orders API last week. Please update the docs in the repo to match.
Explain what an API gateway is.
Write tests for the invoice calculation service, including the edge cases.
What does test-driven development mean?
The test suite has gone red after the refactor, twelve failures. Can you fix the tests?
What is the difference between a mock and a stub?
This controller method is 200 lines long and does five things. Refactor it into something cleaner.
Add a new endpoint that returns the current server time.
We have 340 static analysis errors of the same kind across the codebase. Fix them all in one go.
Rename this one variable in the function I'm looking at.
Check our dependencies for known vulnerabilities and anything badly out of date.
Install the lodash package.
We launch next week. Do a security audit of the app and tell me what an attacker could exploit.
What does HTTPS actually encrypt?

What is Big O notation?
Delete the old build folder for me.
Only change the billing module in this task, please.

What is Meilisearch?
How big a job would it be to add team accounts to the billing system? Give me a rough size.
Add a created_at column to the users table.
I'm new to this codebase. Can you walk me through how checkout works from end to end?
Fix the typo in the README heading.
I want to propose moving our background jobs from cron to a proper queue. Help me write an RFC the team can review.
What does RFC stand for?
We've just decided to use Postgres instead of MySQL for the new service. Log this decision with our reasoning.
What are the main differences between Postgres and MySQL?
Audit this codebase for technical debt and help me prioritise what to pay down first.
What does the term technical debt mean?
We need to split the full_name column into first and last name across four million live customer rows without downtime. Plan the migration.
Write a migration that adds a nullable phone column.
Before we build the new file-sharing feature, threat model it. How could someone abuse it?
What is the OWASP Top 10?
I can't decide between a wizard and a single long form for onboarding. Mock up a few versions so I can try them.
Style this button with a blue background.
Here's our implementation plan in docs/plans/billing.md. Sanity-check it before we start building. Any blockers?
Write me an implementation plan for adding search.
You just told me: "the handler is idempotent because the unique constraint on the dedupe key short-circuits the side effects on retry". Wait, what? You've lost me. Say that again in plain English.
Summarise the README for me.
I've been away for two weeks. Catch me up on what's happened in this project.
Show me the git log for today.
Before we wrap up, let's capture what we learned in this session so we don't lose it.
Commit these changes with a good message.
I'm going on leave tomorrow. Write a brief so a colleague can pick up the payments refactor without needing to ask me anything.
Remind me what the payments refactor was about.
This module is confusing. What does it do?
We launch next week. Is there anything I should check?
Checkout was down for two hours yesterday. Help me write up a blameless post-mortem with actions.
How do I read a stack trace?
Write an on-call runbook for when the queue workers stop processing jobs.
What is a message queue?

Install the Sentry SDK.
Set up a GitHub Actions pipeline that tests every pull request and deploys main to staging with zero downtime.
What does CI stand for?

What is the difference between a bug and a feature request?

Add OAuth sign-in with GitHub to the app.
Rewrite this pull request description in plain English for our client, they're not technical.
Fix the grammar in this sentence: their going to the shop.

Write the error message for when an upload fails.

Write a blog post announcing the invoices feature.
Write a manual QA test plan for the team invitations feature so our testers can run through it.
Write automated tests for the team invitations feature.
Do a full UAT of the checkout journey locally and tell me what's broken.
Write unit tests for the basket total calculation.
What did we ship last week?
